sources.title: GitHub - SharadhNaidu/synapse-sr
sources.snippet: synapse-sr turns a Sentinel-2 L2A scene into a 2.0 m red, green, blue and near-infrared product. The network adds only the structure the 10 m measurement cannot see. Everything the satellite did observe is pinned by a physical model of the instrument and cannot be changed. Every result reports how much of each pixel came from the observation and how much from the learned prior.
